distribution.summary: 黑龙江；陕西；青海；四川；云南；福建；西藏；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) provide mainland province-level records. Beaver & Liu (2010) gives China; Taiwan, adding Taiwan but no new mainland province-level records are inferred from the broad China wording.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) provide explicit host species. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Picea, also Abies, Larix and Pinus, and specifically notes Picea sp. recorded in Taiwan. The Taiwan host is retained at genus level as Picea sp.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetes hectographus Reitter, 1913.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetes hectographus Reitter, 1913, VSN_2427, Scolytinae: Dryocoetini. Beaver & Liu (2010) synonymized O. ater and D. formosanus with D. hectographus after type comparisons.
